scientific_integrity: Analytic proof from classical named approximation and F. and M. Riesz theorems; no numerical proof. Primary August 2026 paper full text unavailable; subsequent closest diagonal paper full HTML inspected. No external independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite pairwise disjoint Jordan curves; distinct bounded diagonal eigenvalues. No claim for infinitely many curves, intersecting curves, arbitrary planar compact supports, or norm convergence. An older implicit analytic-measure result remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Atomic-moment rigidity on finite forests of Jordan curves and minimal diagonal commutants
